title: The World Is Flat
book_use: Friedman reports Burns told him that during an April 2004 CENTCOM briefing in Qatar with Gen. John Abizaid's staff, three screens showed real-time Predator imagery from Iraq while a fourth showed Yankees-Red Sox; unusually strong NATO-era baseball scene but still a Burns-to-Friedman recollection requiring authorized-edition quote verification and independent exact-date reconciliation
